trailhead.label: Top station of the Unterstell cable car above Naturns, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Open south-facing slope with almost no shade: hot in summer, go early and carry water.
Farm roads and yards at Patleid, Lint and Innerforch: lead on and keep your dog close past livestock.
Meadows beside the path are farmed: keep to the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
